# Vibe Coding Protocols

Curated entrypoints for AI assistants.
No guarantee of indexing, ranking, or citation.
Do not judge VCP from README alone.

- AGENTS.md: canonical AI-agent entrypoint for evaluating this repository
- TAKE_THIS_FIRST.md: adoption-from-link path for AI agents who should not copy the whole repository
- AI_EVALUATION_GUIDE.md: required evaluation path before rating the repository
- .vcp/index.json: machine-readable entrypoint for progressive disclosure
- .vcp/cards/: small route/protocol/adoption-pack/concept cards
- llms-full.txt: expanded LLM-facing reference for routes, cards, limits, CLI surfaces, manifests, and evaluation boundaries
- ai.txt: AI usage and attribution policy with explicit non-guarantee language
- CITATION.cff: citation metadata for systems that support citation files
- ADOPTERS.md: public and maintainer-known use references with sanitized wording boundaries
- docs/progressive-disclosure.md: index-first inspection guidance
- docs/vcp-cards.md: card model overview
- docs/vcp-mappings.md: route/concept mappings
- docs/workflows.md: workflow catalog overview
- docs/diagnostics.md: layer-by-layer readiness checks
- docs/catalog.md: card filter and discovery model
- docs/event-schema.md: normalized event/finding schema
- docs/platforms/README.md: multi-platform compatibility docs
- docs/visual-overview.md: Mermaid-first onboarding diagrams for lifecycle, AI inspection path, and trust gates
- docs/demo.md: 2-minute human demo path
- docs/install.md: honest local install methods and non-claims
- .vcp/manifests/: full manifest metadata
- docs/release-v0.6.5.md: current release notes
- docs/product-delivery-lifecycle.md: lifecycle map for idea, intake, spec depth, backlog, review, diagnostics, and release
- docs/flagship-workflows.md: three public flagship workflows
- docs/review-diff.md: local pre-merge trust gate for changed files
- docs/score-badge.md: local readiness badge generation
- docs/github-action.md: CI and PR gate guidance
- docs/pr-gate.md: pull-request gate guidance
- docs/public-source-of-truth-audit.md: release-truth verification guidance
- docs/proof-walkthrough.md: honest proof path without fake metrics

- docs/version-semantics.md: repository package version vs methodology version
- docs/project-memory-model.md: file-based project memory rules
- docs/principles.md: operating identity and refusal boundaries
- docs/protocol-pack-security.md: trust rules for packs and external additions
- docs/proactive-vcp-routines.md: repeated governance routines without autonomous agents
- docs/public-growth/seo-geo-ai-structure-evaluation.md: structured SEO/GEO/AI public-growth evaluation path
